name: repo-summary
title: Repository summary for Gym Membership React demo
description: Summarize the repository purpose, main technologies, key files, and how to run it locally.
prompt: You are an assistant with access to the repository files for a React demo called 'Gym Membership'. Produce a concise summary (3-6 bullet points) including: overall purpose, tech stack (frameworks/libraries), key directories and files to inspect (entry points, main components, styles), npm scripts of interest, and one-sentence suggested next steps for a developer onboarding to this repo. If package.json exists, include the install and start commands verbatim. If README.md exists, include a one-line note about its existence. Keep the response short and actionable.
